description: Device companies scored against the others in a procedure family on innovation pace (new FDA decisions, market entries), recall and report signals (recalls, MAUDE reports above the category), commercial momentum (share of the family's Medicare cases through surgeons they engage, this year against last) and financial capacity, with a position: Leader, Innovator, Commercial mover or Fewer engaged surgeons. Give a family for its landscape, a company for its families, or both. Needs the product and company coverage add-on.

company.description: Company name ("Stryker") or slug from search.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.
